# Rat Genome Database (RGD)

> RGD is a comprehensive genomics research database providing integrated rat, mouse, and human genome data, bioinformatics tools, and phenotypic information for comparative genomics research.

Maintained by the Medical College of Wisconsin, RGD serves as a central repository for genomic and phenotypic data with tools for genome browsing, variant analysis, literature search, and ontology-based research. The database supports data submission, community projects, and multi-species comparative genomics.

## Key Topics

- Rat Genome Database
- JBrowse genome browser
- Genomic analysis
- Ontologies
- OntoMate literature search
- Variant Visualizer
- PhenoMiner
- Data submission
- Strain registration
- Bioinformatics tools
- Disease portals
- REST API
- Comparative genomics
- FAIR principles
- Alliance Genome

## Core Tools & Resources

- [JBrowse Genome Browser](https://rgd.mcw.edu/rgdweb/jbrowse2/listing.jsp): JBrowse genome browser for rat, mouse, and human genomic visualization
- [OntoMate Literature Search](https://ontomate.rgd.mcw.edu/QueryBuilder): OntoMate literature search tool using ontology-based query builder
- [Variant Visualizer](https://rgd.mcw.edu/rgdweb/front/config.html): Variant Visualizer tool for analyzing genomic variation across strains
- [Ontology Enrichment](https://rgd.mcw.edu/rgdweb/enrichment/start.html): Ontology enrichment analysis tool for gene annotation and genomic analysis
- [Genome Information](https://rgd.mcw.edu/rgdweb/report/genomeInformation/genomeInformation.html): Genome information and bioinformatics tools for genomic search

## Data & Projects

- [RGD Projects](https://rgd.mcw.edu/rgdweb/projects/project.html): RGD community projects including genome browser and disease portals
- [Data Download Repository](https://download.rgd.mcw.edu): File repository and download directory for RGD genomics data
- [Data Submission Guide](https://rgd.mcw.edu/wg/registration-entry): Data submission guide for strain, gene, allele, and QTL registration

## Documentation & Guides

- [About RGD](https://rgd.mcw.edu/wg/about-us): Overview of RGD mission, FAIR principles, and multi-species genomics
- [Video Tutorials](https://rgd.mcw.edu/wg/home/rgd_rat_community_videos): Video tutorials and educational content for RGD tools and resources
- [Citing RGD](https://rgd.mcw.edu/wg/citing-rgd): Citation guidelines and RRID identifiers for RGD resources
- [Grant Resources](https://rgd.mcw.edu/wg/grants): Grant writing resources and rat genome data for research proposals

## Publications & News

- [RGD Publications](https://rgd.mcw.edu/wg/home/rat-genome-database-publications): Publications by RGD faculty on genomic and phenotypic data research
- [RGD News](https://rgd.mcw.edu/wg/news2): News and updates about RGD, publications, and rat genome resources

## Support

- [Contact Us](https://rgd.mcw.edu/rgdweb/contact/contactus.html): Contact information and support resources for RGD users
